notes: The last step. The standalone Screener tab is gone, and with it the last place the product pretended a screen and a cohort were two different things. Everything it did has a home: saved screens migrated to cohorts (3.19.0), the full expressive builder — every field, the where-clause, percentile predicates, live preview — lives in the Cohorts tab (3.20.0), and index membership is a predicate (3.18.0). So the tab and its dead renderers are removed. Nothing that pointed at the Screener is orphaned. A persisted "active tab = Screener" from old saved state lands on Cohorts. The agent's open_screene
